title: Central Maui wastewater reclamation facility funding
summary: On Oct. 19, 2026, the environmental management director said the Central Maui wastewater plant is projected to start in late 2029 or later, but should be running before the school needs service in July 2031. The 14.9-acre site is under 15 acres, so it does not need the Land Use Commission. The county holds environmental permits and is working through land approvals.
